verdict.rationale: Google's first-party model pages give exact token limits, not ranges. Gemini 4 Argon is documented with a 1,048,576 unified context window and a 65,536 default max output (up to 1,048,576 with long decode), and the all-models page claims per-model context and max-output specs. Missing for 10: verbatim precise limits shown for models beyond the flagship, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented limits hold.

support.subject: As a developer, every model's context window and token budgets are documented precisely — input/output limits per model, not marketing ranges

citations.quote: **Context window (unified input and output token limit)** 1,048,576 ... **Max output** 65,536 (default synchronous) / up to 1,048,576 (with [long decode])
Model code gemini-4-argon, Context 1M tokens, Max output 65K / 1M tokens
